The five artists with the most albums (by counting Album rows per Artist) are:

1) Iron Maiden — 21 albums
2) Led Zeppelin — 14 albums
3) Deep Purple — 11 albums
4) Metallica — 10 albums
5) U2 — 10 albums

Note: Metallica and U2 are tied with 10 albums each for the 4th–5th position.
sql_used:
SELECT a.ArtistId, a.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count
FROM Artist a
LEFT JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
ORDER BY album_count DESC, a.Name
LIMIT 50;
assumptions: "Most albums" means the number of rows in the Album table associated with each Artist (i.e., count of Album records per Artist).
